features.name: Total Win Bar

review:
Bouncy Bombs is a 6x5 fruit scatter-pays slot where wins go into a Total Win Bar and bomb multipliers go off at the end of the round. Normal bombs show 2x to 4x, revealing bombs hide values from 5x upward, and all bombs on the grid add their values together before multiplying the total.

The bombs only pay if the round had at least one win, so a full board of bombs with no connection is a near miss. It's a very readable design, similar to other tumble-and-bomb games, and the cap is 10,000x in every mode.
